title: Classify exact rank-two matrix-algebra right-vector costs (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof with an exhaustive finite certificate: for every field K and block size m>=3, every ordinary rank-two target on two roles over M_m(K) has exact paid right-vector cost two or three. The paid alphabet is I+u y^T with base-field right vectors and arbitrary free GL2(K) maps.

```text
Write M=A B, with A=[A1;A2] injective and B=[B1 B2] surjective through K^2.
cost(M)=3 iff
  B1=c1 b and B2=c2 b for a common nonzero row b and a basis c1,c2;
  every nonzero scalar combination s A1+t A2 has rank two.
Otherwise cost(M)=2.
```

This answers the rank-two, two-role part of Open next question 1 of #4772. The new proof classifies the deficient rank-two factor pencils and supplies a literal three-factor word for every exceptional target. The two-factor criterion and its attaining word are cited from #4276, not re-audited.

The explicit target `[[E11,E21],[E21,E31]]` has ordinary rank two and exact cost three over every field and every m>=3. Only `research/right-vector-rank-two/` is added. No new kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier change.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Nick Petalas #4772/#4276/#4265/#4243 for the open question, rank bound, criteria and free-map normal form; Wentao Li #4099 following #2513 for the alphabet; and ToikY #4334, followed by Nick Petalas #4601/#4749, for the related cost framework. Rank factorization and the rank-one pencil lemma are classical linear algebra. Predecessor files and credit are preserved.

## Evidence

- Before: #4772 proves ordinary rank-one cost n and leaves higher singular ranks open. After: PROOF.md gives the complete ordinary rank-two classification on two roles for m>=3, including both attaining cases.
- All 2,542,806 binary 6 by 6 rank-two targets are enumerated uniquely through their canonical column spaces and surjective right factors. Exactly 2,535,162 cost two and 7,644 cost three. The literal full-matrix two-factor criterion agrees with the separately computed new classification on every target. All 7,644 exceptional legal three-factor words multiply to their complete targets.
- The complete target/cost table has SHA256 `37a68b33c4175157da0147c0b165f82909956a87750ff354a366f542f432c623`. Separate dense chart solvers check both attaining and excluded categories. Ten explicit field/block cases cover F2,F3,F4,F5,F7 at m=3,4; all 64 binary dirty inputs and the boundary, solver, alphabet, omission and reversal controls pass.
- Both registered warning-strict commands pass locally on CPython 3.12, timed separately at 2.04 s and 2.06 s, below their 120-second limits. Normal and optimized receipts agree. The registered package runner passes. In-memory compilation, JSON parsing, function-size checks and the staged whitespace check pass.
- Eight-file committed-byte/source-history preflight and official committed export integrity pass at `7fdbf8040ea9a957af0576067df2d9cb6fcf0e51`. Optimized Git-free export replay with PATH=/nonexistent emits the identical generated receipt. The receipt binds all six package files and both live predecessor proof files by SHA256; none is handwritten.

Canonical main is pinned at `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7, and was refreshed before committing. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19131544).

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The all-field statement is a written scoped proof using the cited predecessor criterion. The exhaustive target census covers F2 and m=3; the other fields have the stated example checks. The block-size restriction is essential: at m=2, ordinary rank-two diag(0,I2) costs one. More roles and other ordinary ranks remain unclassified. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

The formal factors overwrite data. Native coefficient preparation, routing, reversible dirty-state restoration, precision, stock and the complete recursive invoice remain unknown. No complete multiplication theorem follows. Lean, Docker and selected-construction replay were outside this isolated result and were not run. Every registered local command ran successfully; no package check is deferred to CI.

## Open next questions

- Classify ordinary rank-three targets on two roles over M_m(K), m>=4. Start with a named deficient 3 by m matrix pencil; the rank-one pencil lemma here no longer suffices.
- Specify one literal native producer/consumer, coefficient preparation and overwrite/restoration contract, then price the complete invoice before using these formal factors in a supplier.

## Related open work

- #4776, head `0764ab259a8ce496a4c5d4debeed4c4e4d9f7ca4`, classifies zero-residue square-zero radical pencils in the same alphabet. Its local coefficient algebra differs from M_m(K), m>=3, so no counted target or cost census overlaps.
- #4780, head `a4436fab4164eccc498d4d9885eec68211c869de`, proves the singular rank-one component threshold over pure field products. Matrix-algebra blocks are outside its threshold theorem. Under the diagonal embedding of k nonzero rank-one components, ordinary rank is k; k=2 lies at m=2, outside our m>=3 theorem, and k>=3 lies above our rank-two domain. There is no overlapping numerical count to compare.
- #4781, head `b838121c65e1bfd17a65466c95940eb00f12a225`, counts rank-one residue lifts over proper extension-field local algebras. Those scalar-residue local algebras differ from the noncommutative matrix blocks here, so no lift or target-count total overlaps.

- #4784, head `4d0a6363fe4f45dd9a769f5b74d02fc5d9061ae3`, proves an exact degree/cost distribution for invertible targets over F_q[t]. The polynomial coefficient algebra and invertible endpoints differ from the singular matrix-algebra targets here, so no target-cost count or distribution overlaps.
- #4787, head `4b58e8cd5690bd35cf01b0018eefa2c39a298920`, proves arbitrary-role exact costs for invertible targets over local algebras. M_m(K), m>=3, is nonlocal and our targets are singular, so both endpoint and algebra domains are disjoint. No shared target-cost number is asserted.

All five titles and bodies were read. The account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM were refreshed before DONE. No numerical disagreement was found on an overlapping domain; these five endpoint/algebra domains have no common census with this package. Merged #4772 is the direct predecessor; its rank-one endpoints are disjoint from this rank-two classification. Merged #4265/#4276 include binary m=2 finite examples, while this classification assumes m>=3.
